info.description: A single member card on /our-team (Figma node 1126:54624) and its 'View Profile' modal (Figma node 1126:55196, both file foaJFuv0vRX8nD43o0ylgB). Card fields: name, role/designation, photo — nothing else (no social links, no department: none of those are drawn on any card). Modal fields: `bio` — the modal (node 1126:56704) only ever shows ONE worked example (Anurag Magoo's own bio paragraph); no other member has bio text drawn anywhere in the Figma file, so `bio` is optional and left empty for every other member rather than inventing filler copy — see seed.ts's own comment on this content type.
